newsitem.title: UK: UK retail sales up 0.4 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: UK retail sales up 0.4 pct in Oct.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics (ONS) released the following seasonally adjusted data on UK retail sales in October.
RETAIL SALES VOLUME OCT SEPT (SEPT PREL)
Market forecasts had centred on a 0.5 percent rise in retail sales on the month and a year-on-year increase of 4.1 percent.
BY SECTOR (percentage gain, minus indicates fall)
The average weekly non-seasonally adjusted value of retail sales in October was 3,260 million stg, 6.6 percent up on October 1995.
In value terms, retail sales rose by 6.4 percent in the three months to end October on the same period a year earlier.
* The ONS said the 4.0 percent rise in retail sales on a three-month versus three-months a year ago basis, was the largest rise since September 1994.
